extract_batch with missing URI input

```rust title="Rust"
use xberg::extract_batch;
use xberg::ExtractInput;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let inputs_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"[{"kind":"uri","uri":"/nonexistent/a.pdf"}]"#).unwrap();
    let inputs = serde_json::from_value::<Vec<ExtractInput>>(inputs_json).unwrap();
    let config = Default::default();
    let result = extract_batch(inputs, &config).await;
    println!("{:?}", result);
}
```
